Application Data.NAME: Sunny Delight Dairy & Ice Cream Shop
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunny Delight Dairy & Ice Cream Shop operates as a retail establishment specializing in the sale of a wide variety of dairy products, gourmet ice creams, and frozen desserts. Our business model focuses on providing high-quality, locally sourced ingredients, with a commitment to ingredient sourcing transparency to meet consumer demand for allergen-safe and ethically sourced products. We do not conduct any on-site cooking or heating processes, ensuring compliance with fire safety regulations. Our shop offers a vibrant shopping experience with options for seasonal flavors and limited-time specialty products. We prioritize customer safety and satisfaction, implementing strict food handling practices and maintaining our establishment to the highest health standards. Additionally, we use a secure point-of-sale system for processing customer transactions, which includes the necessary data protection measures.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On July 12, 2023, a water leak occurred in the refrigeration unit due to a malfunction, causing $1,200 worth of ice cream to spoil. The incident was promptly addressed, and the refrigeration unit was repaired and inspected. Status: Closed.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, UL Listed, Fire Rated, Combination Safe
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fence with barbed wire and 24/7 monitored alarm system.
